props.name: referenceA4
props.description: Concert pitch for A4, in hertz, when controlled.

props.name: onReferenceA4Change
props.description: Called when the person changes the reference.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Cents either side of the note that count as in tune.

props.name: minFrequency
props.description: Lowest pitch listened for. Lower costs more work per frame.

props.name: onPitch
props.description: Called with each new reading, or null when the sound stops.
